text: 1.Mode of Study and Period of Study for Doctorate Education Full-time and part-time. Generally it will take 4 years and could also be extended, but no more than 8 years. 2. Accommodations Students can live in the students’ apartments arranged by the School of International Education, or solve accommodations by themselves. 3. Application Time for Preparatory Courses From 1st May to 31st December, 2010. 4. Formal Admission Review During the pre-master education, the School of International Education will achieve the follow-up application procedures for applicants before March 1, 2011. Qualification review and related matters of the admission interview will be published on the website of the Graduate Admission Office, CUPL in mid-May, 2011. 5.Interview for Formal Admission The interview is a comprehensive assessment including professional standards and level of Chinese language. 6. Formal Admission and Entry into CUPL After the interview and the comprehensive assessment, the list of the admitted students will be published in early June, 2011. The School of International Education of CUPL will send off the Admission Letter and the visa application form in late June, 2011. 7. Date of Formal Registration in CUPL The registration time in CUPL will be in early September 2011; for the concrete time, the students could refer to the Admission Letter. The admitted students should achieve the admission and registration procedures in School of International Education of China University of Political Science and Law in accordance with the requirements on the Admission Lette. 8. Tuition The tuition of doctorate education for foreign students in China University of Political Science and Law in 2011 has not been determined; the instruction for the tuition will be sent to the admitted students together with the Admission Letter. Professional application service fee: 30,000 RMB (including the related costs used for: Chinese courses, major courses, guidance to studying abroad, selection of majors and completion of relevant procedures etc.) for those who are under HSK level 6 want to directly enter into doctoral degree study without studying preparatory courses. Note 1: The tuition of doctorate education for foreign students in China University of Political Science and Law in 2009 was 33,000 RMB per person. Note 2: The tuition must be paid by RMB. 9. Scholarship For the scholarship application, the admitted students could refer to the detailed information of the School of International Education of CUPL.
